Bihar ke nalanda jile ke sarmera thana kshetr antargat parnama ganv men andhvishvas ke shak aur mamuli bat ko lekar huee kahasuni men ek dil dahla dene vali ghatna samne aaee hai. yahan parosi sadhu manjhi ne 36 varshiy yuvak samant manjhi (pita svargiy naresh manjhi) ki lathi-dandon se berahmi se pitaee kar hatya kar di.
